I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging. All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now report v2.3.0, with status `rolled_out`.

I haven't yet confirmed that the error rate has recovered on v2.3.0. Someone should also investigate the v2.3.1 failure before it is redeployed.
